newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Petrofina to be focus on Brussels bourse Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Petrofina to be focus on Brussels bourse Tuesday.

text.p: Belgian shares ended nearly one percent higher on Monday, in line with neighbouring markets, which rallied as European currencies weakened against the dollar, lifting dollar-earners' shares.
Dealers said the dollar's strength was due to worries the French election victory would lead to a weaker euro. By 1500 GMT, the dollar was quoted 35.64 francs, from 35.14 on Friday.
The Bel-20 index .BFX closed 21.54 points or 0.96 percent higher at 2269.31 on strong volume of 3.6 billion francs.
Dealers expect oil group PetroFina's shares to be well-bid on Tuesday, when the PetroFina warrant expires.

The warrant allows investors to buy Petrofina shares at 14,500 francs, above the 12,425 close on Monday. Dealers expected the share would be boosted to more than 14,500 francs, otherwise the firm would miss the much-needed new capital.

Pharmaceutical group UCB, which said on Friday it would book a surplus of the order of one billion francs in 1997 following a share sale by one of its subsidiaries, was volume leader on Tuesday, with a 0.9 pct gain at 96,4350 francs.
Among blue chip shares with dollar income and franc costs, retailer Delhaize, non-ferrous metals group Union Miniere SA (UM) were up nearly three percent.

The discount of shares of French bank Credit Local de France against those of its Belgian partner Credit Communal (CCB) narrowed to six percent at the close, after widening to 11.5 percent in morning trade.
CLF closed 0.74 percent lower at 535 French francs (or 3,273 Belgian francs) after falling nearly six percent, while CCB was down 1.0 percent at 3,480 Belgian francs.
Both shares should theoretically be at par, as both groups are in a 50-50 percent cross-shareholdership relation via their Dexia alliance, each controlling half of the other's banking operations.
The Dexia group is focussed on credits to local public authorities. It recently acquired a stake in Italian bank Crediop.
